insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Total sales grew +4.2% WoW to $10,283, powered by organic revenue rising +10.9% to $8,101. The Daily Energy Gummies 60 Count surged to $1,137 (+48.1%) with sessions up +26.7%, the Daily Passion Gummies 60 Count grew to $2,045 (+16.2%), and the Daily Sleep Gummies 60 Count led at $3,735 (+10.9%) with a 61.1% conversion rate. Monday, Nov 9 was the peak day at $1,908.

**Metrics to Watch —** PPC revenue eased to $2,181 (-14.9%) even as ad spend rose to $2,297 (prior $2,058), so paid traffic converted less efficiently this week; organic more than made up for it at $8,101 (+10.9%). The Daily Sleep Gummies 28 Count slipped to $599 (-18.9%) as its CVR fell to 19.9% (-23.7%), and Friday, Nov 13 was the softest day at $881. We are tightening ad targeting so spend goes to the terms that convert.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** ROAS came in at 0.95x (prior 1.25x) and TACoS at 22.3% (prior 20.86%), with ACOS at 105.3%, a 0.46% ad CTR and a 7.39% ad conversion rate. We are correcting this by cutting bids on search terms that spend without converting and moving budget toward the Daily Sleep Gummies 60 Count and Daily Energy Gummies 60 Count, where shoppers are already buying.

**Actions This Week —** Pause or lower bids on non-converting search terms to bring ACOS down from 105.3% and ROAS back above 1.25x. Shift budget to the Daily Energy Gummies 60 Count to build on its +48.1% growth and to the Daily Sleep Gummies 60 Count to use its 61.1% conversion rate. Test new ad creative to lift the 0.46% ad CTR heading into the holiday season.
